title: cyphostemma lanigerum
intro: Cyphostemma lanigerum, commonly known as "Wild Raisin" or "Kareeboom", is a plant species in the grape family (Vitaceae) native to southern Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve blood pressure, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cyphostemma lanigerum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective properties, which may contribute to its ability to promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Cyphostemma lanigerum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
